senses.gloss: (b. h., cmp. יָצָא) [to break through, spread,] to kindle.

units: Yoma VI, 7 (67ᵇ) משיַצִּית האור ברובן ed. from the time that he (the officiating priest) causes the fire to spread over the major portion of them; [Ms. M. משתַּצִּית את האור from the time that thou (whoever it may be) causest &c.; Ms. M. 2 משתִּיצַּת האור (Kal, אור fem.) that the fire seizes &c.; Y. ed. משיִצַּת; Ms. L. משיוּצַת (Hof.) when fire has been set; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note]. Ib. 68ᵇ המַצִּית את האור he who kindles (stirs) the fire, contrad. to השורף who attends to the burning of the pieces.

<cite ref="Menachot 26b:10">Men. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>משתצית בו את האור</he> (Ms. M. <he>משיצית האור</he>, Ms. R. 1 <he>משתיצת</he>); <cite ref="Sotah 15a:4">Sot. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>משתיצת האור</he>. Men. l. c. bot. <he>לא משכחת לה שתצית האור וכ׳</he> (Ms. R. 1 <he>שתיצת</he>; Ms. M. <he>שיצית</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) it is impossible that the fire should have seized the major portion of it (at sunset).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 2:4">Tam. II, 4</cite> <he>שהיו מַצִּיתִין וכ׳</he> where they set the kindling wood on fire, v. <cite ref="A01886"><he>אֲלִיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 38a">Ab. Zar. 38ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="A00309"><he>אַגָּם</he></cite>. Y. B. Kam. II, 3ᵃ <he>במַצִּית את האור וכ׳</he> setting fire to each ear of corn separately. Bab.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 22b">B. Kam. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>בשה׳ בגופו וכ׳</he> when he set fire to the body of the slave; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be set to, to be made to spread. Yoma l. c., v. supra.—Part. מוּצַת.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 59a">B. Mets. 59ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 38:25">Gen. XXXVIII, 25</cite>) <he>א״ת מוצאת אלא מוּצַת</he> Ar. s. v. <cite ref="A03391"><he>א״ת</he></cite> (= <he>מוצתת</he>, missing in ed. a. Mss.; cmp.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite> a. ‘Rashi’ a. l. <he>מוצת קרי</he>) read not, ‘she was carried out’, but ‘she was about to be burnt’.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 12">Num. R. s. 12</cite> (expl. <he>זהב מופז</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 10:18">I Kings X, 18</cite>) <he>דומה לגפרית מוּצֶתֶת באש</he> it looks like sulphur when fire is set to it; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:10">Cant. R. to III, 10</cite> <he>מוצצת</he> (corr. acc.).
